name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source meeting scheduling polls: share a link, collect availability and pick the best date, with PostgreSQL and bundled S3 storage for uploads.

alerts.message: Sign-in uses emailed codes, so set SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_SECURE (true only for port 465), SMTP_USER and SMTP_PWD (both or neither) to a working mail server and SUPPORT_EMAIL to an address it may send from, then redeploy.

Set INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAIL to your email, sign in with it and open /control-panel to claim the admin role. Anyone can register until you restrict ALLOWED_EMAILS or turn off registration in the control panel.
